ledger.claim: The rider's 28% figure is measured against the wrong comparator, and on this record I concede that it cannot stand. trip_record.solo_optimal_distance_km of 15.80 km is the unmatched single-rider route; because trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL, POL-RD-12 fixes the POL-RD-01 baseline at the matched-itinerary optimal of 19.40 km recorded in trip_record.optimal_distance_km, and the platform put that pooled route to the rider before departure ('Co-rider matched... Estimated 19.4 km, 34 min', delivered 18:42:04 and read 18:42:31, trip started 18:47:10). The Hougang mileage the rider objects to is real - the trace shows the loop - but it is distance attributable to collecting a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary, which POL-RD-12 excludes from excess before POL-RD-01 is applied, and POL-RD-12 states that a claim measured against solo_optimal_distance_km fails on that ground alone.

Even on the governing baseline the arithmetic does not reach the gate, and I concede that too. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 20.18 km and governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km; against the matched-itinerary optimal of 19.40 km that is an excess of 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed 0.80 km in absolute terms AND 20% of optimal, and both tests must pass: 0.78 km falls 0.02 km short of the absolute floor. No deviation is established, POL-RD-02's recomputation never runs, and the charged total of SGD 26.83 stands; the contested SGD 6.00 is not recoverable on this record.

No external-cause adjustment can enlarge that baseline, which keeps the excess at the full measured figure rather than some reduced one. The bundle's only traffic advisory is EV-ADVIS-00113-01 and it is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; I disclose that impairment expressly, and under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact carries no fact even though its absence is itself citable. No advisory covers the Punggol-Hougang-CTE corridor in the 18:41-19:23 window, so POL-RD-03 cannot be satisfied on this record and no closure-adjusted optimal exists to substitute for the booked 19.40 km; under POL-RD-13 an external traffic assertion that is not tied to an advisory carries no weight.

The rider's claim is not one the policy singles out for stronger proof, so it should not be scrutinised as though it were. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the trigger of 4 in POL-RD-08, and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0; the additional-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 therefore does not apply to this rider and the claim falls to be decided on the trace rather than on the rider's claim history. Those two fields are the only profile values I ask the tribunal to use, and POL-GEN-01 confines them to exactly this test.

The measurement the rider's complaint rests on is sound, not defective. EV-GPS-00113 carries 217 fixes at a 10 second interval over 100% coverage, with no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of limbs POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires and the excess is run along a continuous trace rather than interpolated across a dropout. The rider's claim therefore fails only on the size of the excess against the POL-RD-01 thresholds, and not on the quality of the evidence the rider brought.

This trip is a RYDE_POOL booking, so under POL-RD-12 the POL-RD-01 baseline is the matched-itinerary optimal of 19.4 km recorded on the trip record, which the routing engine quoted at match time for the pooled route Punggol to the Hougang co-rider pickup to Raffles Place. The 15.8 km figure the rider measures against is carried on the same record as solo_optimal_distance_km for reference only, and under POL-RD-12 a claim that measures excess against the solo optimal has cited the wrong field and fails on that ground alone.

On the governing trace figure the excess does not come close to the POL-RD-01 gate. The trace measures 20.18 km against a matched-itinerary optimal of 19.4 km, an excess of 0.78 km or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be greater than 20% of optimal (here 3.88 km) AND greater than 0.8 km absolute; both tests fail, no deviation is established, and by the express terms of POL-RD-01 the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The result does not turn on which distance field is used. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km (20.18 km) govern over trip_record.actual_distance_km, and the trip record's rounded 20.2 km copy yields an excess of exactly 0.80 km - not greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and still far short of the 20% test. On either figure the establishment test fails and the driver prevails.

The Hougang leg is a platform-matched co-rider pickup, not a driver's detour. POL-RD-12 provides that distance attributable to collecting or setting down a co-rider on a platform-matched pooled itinerary is never a deviation and is excluded from excess before POL-RD-01 is applied. The system message on this trip records the co-rider match and the Hougang Central pickup, and the driver's on-record statement confirms he drove the route the app showed him.

The rider was notified of the pooled route before the trip began, which contradicts the assertion that a 28%-longer route was unagreed. The platform's match notification was sent at 18:42:04, was read at 18:42:31, and stated in terms that the pooled route now included one pickup at Hougang Central with an estimated 19.4 km and 34 minutes; the vehicle did not start until 18:47:10. The rider therefore knew the matched itinerary and its estimate before departing.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and cannot discharge it. POL-RD-08 requires the rider to show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired trace. This trace is not impaired: 217 fixes at the expected 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not engaged. The measured excess of 0.78 km nonetheless misses the threshold, so the burden never shifts to the driver.

No repeat-deviation pattern can be asserted against this driver. POL-RD-06's test is met only where driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more, or where that figure divided by completed_trips_90d is 0.05 or more: here the flags count is 0 and the completed-trips figure is 471, so no pattern is established - and in any event no material deviation has been found on this trip that would require the check. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day field this test names and is not relied on.

ledger.claim: There is no billing-integrity defect that could survive the failure of the deviation claim. The fare breakdown charges no ERP gantries and no tolls, and carries no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates at nor ends at an airport. The POL-RD-09(4) standalone correction is the only refund POL-RD-01 preserves where no deviation exists, and nothing on this fare engages it.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires, so the case is decidable on the present record without sending it to a human. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00113; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) so limb (3) is not engaged; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing artifact; and no computed refund approaches the SGD 150.00 ceiling. The ruling should therefore be NO_ACTION, not ESCALATE.

No traffic advisory is on file - EV-ADVIS-00113-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, and that impairment and issue code (MISSING_ARTIFACT) are disclosed here - and none is needed on the driver's case. The driver asserts a platform-matched pooled itinerary, not an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-03 is not engaged. Under POL-RD-13 an assertion that cites no advisory identifier cannot be invoked against a missing one, so the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation trigger.

NO_ACTION is party-relative and here it favours the driver. This dispute was filed by the rider, and the fare ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00; under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION leaves the present payment state exactly as it stands, so the fare remains with the driver and no amount is restored or refunded.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the fare of SGD 26.83 stands. No deviation is established, so nothing is refunded and nothing is paid to the driver.

Baseline. This was a RYDE_POOL booking, so POL-RD-12 fixes the route-deviation baseline at the MATCHED-ITINERARY optimal of 19.40 km recorded in trip_record.optimal_distance_km (EV-TRIP-00113) — the pooled route the platform computed at match time for Punggol → Hougang co-rider pickup → Raffles Place. The 15.80 km solo_optimal_distance_km on the same record is reference only. The rider's '15.8 km, 28% longer' comparison is measured against the wrong field and, on POL-RD-12's express terms, fails on that ground alone; the rider's advocate has conceded this, and I record the concession.

Measurement. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 20.18 km (EV-GPS-00113) and governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 20.2 km. Excess = 20.18 − 19.40 = 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation ESTABLISHED only where the excess is greater than 0.8 km absolute AND greater than 20% of optimal; both must pass. 0.78 km does not exceed 0.8 km, and 4.02% is far short of 20%. Even on the rounded 20.2 km copy the excess is exactly 0.80 km — still not greater than the 0.8 km floor. No deviation is established, and by POL-RD-01 the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip.

The Hougang leg. The distance to the Hougang co-rider pickup is a platform-matched pooled itinerary leg, not a driver's detour. POL-RD-12 excludes such distance from excess before POL-RD-01 is applied, and the platform's own match notification (MSG-00113-001, delivered 18:42:04, read 18:42:31, before the 18:47:10 start) told the rider the pooled route now included one Hougang pickup at an estimated 19.4 km / 34 min. The driver's chat reply (MSG-00113-003) and his statement are consistent with the record.

Trace quality. The trace is unimpaired: 217 fixes at the expected 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds (EV-GPS-00113). POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not engaged, so the measurement is sound and the rider's burden under POL-RD-08 fails only on the size of the excess, not on the quality of the evidence.

Fare recomputation. Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund issues. (For completeness, even if it ran, recomputed_fare against the matched optimal is SGD 25.67 against a charged_total of SGD 26.83 — about SGD 1.20, not the SGD 6.00 contested.) There is no billing-integrity defect: the fare carries no ERP gantries, no tolls, and no airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates at nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged.

Profile claims. The POL-RD-06 repeat-deviation check produces nothing: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 471 completed trips in 90 days, and no MATERIAL deviation exists to trigger the check anyway; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags was mentioned only to be set aside and was correctly not relied on. The rider's claim history (deviation_claims_60d = 1) is below POL-RD-08's trigger of 4, so no additional corroboration is required of this rider. Both profile claims were answered and neither changes the result.

Escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires. Trip id TRP-00113 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact; and no refund approaches the SGD 150.00 ceiling. The only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00113-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact and neither side relies on it as carrying one, so its absence is citable but is neither decisive nor a POL-RD-10(5) trigger under POL-RD-13(1).

Confidence and execution. The deciding facts — the trace distance and the matched-itinerary optimal — are carried by EV-GPS-00113 and EV-TRIP-00113, both weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The missing advisory's 0.0 weight does not lower the cap because it carries no deciding fact. The monetary effect is nil, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00.

No referral is produced. POL-RD-06(c) requires a MATERIAL deviation for its driver-conduct referral and none exists; POL-RD-09(4) has no unmatched charge line to refer; and no other clause in force produces one. Under POL-GEN-03, on this rider-filed dispute NO_ACTION leaves payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 exactly as they stand. Both parties retain the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
